projects.name: AI Voice Agent for Doctor Appointment Booking
projects.description: Fully autonomous conversational voice agent supporting natural multi-turn interactions. Speech-to-Text (Whisper), LLM dialogue management with long-term context memory, intent classification and Text-to-Speech. Stateful workflows for slot checking, booking, rescheduling, cancellation and fallbacks. Reduced manual booking workload by 70%.

projects.name: Deepfake Video Detection System
projects.description: Hybrid CNN-RNN (LSTM/Transformer) architecture using spatial frame features and temporal dynamics. Preprocessing with MTCNN face detection, alignment, frame sampling and augmentation. Optimized real-time, low-latency inference engine.

projects.name: Multi-Model ML Prediction Platform
projects.description: Multi-task learning system for placement delay prediction, salary estimation and risk classification with a shared feature store. Owned data ingestion, feature engineering, training, Optuna tuning and A/B testing. Dockerized and deployed as a REST API (Flask + Gunicorn).

projects.name: DragGAN — Interactive Generative Image Manipulation
projects.description: Implemented and enhanced the DragGAN framework for precise point-based real-time image editing. Improved training stability and reduced artifacts through custom loss functions and architectural refinements.

projects.name: Real-Time Pothole Detection & Road Anomaly System
projects.description: Real-time pothole and road damage detection using YOLOv8 and EfficientDet. Achieved high mAP and deployed on edge devices for smart-city infrastructure monitoring.

projects.name: LLM-Powered Personalized Recommendation & Q&A System
projects.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation system with a fine-tuned LLM for domain-specific question answering. Vector database (FAISS/Chroma) with hybrid search and prompt optimization.

projects.name: AI Travel Planner with Multi-Agent Architecture
projects.description: AI travel itinerary generator using LangChain, OpenAI API and a multi-agent collaboration framework. Responsive full-stack web app with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS with dynamic visualizations.
